description: This receipt is a thermal point-of-sale (POS) receipt issued by Shoe Dept. at the Waterloo Premium Outlets in Waterloo, New York, United States. The header includes the retailer name, store location, telephone number, store number, and register number. The transaction section records the receipt reference, transaction date and time, and a retail purchase entry. The financial summary contains Subtotal, Sales Tax, Total, Amount Tendered, and Change Due. The integrated payment section documents a Visa credit card transaction with the masked account number, merchant ID, application label, EMV authentication data, AID, TVR, and issuer verification information. The lower portion includes the customer's loyalty ID, loyalty member name, points earned, current loyalty point balance, online shopping information, customer service contact details, and a final verification section for store personnel. This is a standard U.S. retail footwear POS receipt with integrated EMV payment and loyalty program functionality.
